items.q: How often do agents pipe CLI output into head, tail or grep?
items.a: About **a quarter of all calls**, and **over half** for read-heavy commands.
The agent **re-writing the same cut by hand** every time—each one a guess where the answer is.

items.q: How can a pipe hide a failure?
items.a: Without pipefail the **exit code is the last command's**, and tail can **cut the error itself**.

items.q: What should a failing tool print last?
items.a: A **short failure summary** and a **path to the full log**.

items.q: What should you ship first for agents?
items.a: **Ranges and limits**, plus a hint like 'showing 20 of 300, add offset'.
Agents **follow skills and help text literally**—95 of 95 searches kept passing a dead flag.

items.q: How do you get evals for an agent-facing tool?
items.a: Replay the **commands agents already ran**; what they did next is a **rough answer key**.

items.q: What signals a failing case in a transcript?
items.a: The agent **retrying the call with different arguments**.

items.q: What should you measure instead of tokens?
items.a: **Turns and right answers**—token savings can be just 0.5%.
